name: Marvoxa AI: Chat & Voice Agent
author: marvoxa

sections.description:
Marvoxa AI puts an AI agent on your WordPress site that answers every visitor in seconds, by chat or by voice, day and night. It learns your pages and your WooCommerce products by itself, so its answers are about your business: prices, stock, delivery, returns, opening hours, anything on your site.

Install the plugin, click Connect, and the chat is live. No code to paste.

What it does

  • Answers by chat and voice. A chat on every page. Visitors can type, or tap the call button and talk to it, and it answers out loud with a live transcript.
  • Knows your site. It learns your pages (About, FAQ, contact, policies) and keeps up as you change them.
  • Knows your WooCommerce store. Products, prices, sale prices, stock, categories and shipping, brought up to date every hour and a couple of minutes after a product changes.
  • Speaks your visitors’ language. It answers in the language they write or speak in.
  • Your team can step in. See every conversation, get alerted when someone asks for a person, and take over the chat in one click. Hand it back to the AI when you’re done.
  • Every lead, saved. Names, phone numbers and emails visitors leave in the chat are saved as leads, with what they wanted.
  • Looks like your site. Pick the colour, picture, first message and the quick questions visitors can tap, with a live preview.
  • Pick the voice it speaks with. Hear each voice before you choose.
  • Choose where it shows. Switch the chat off, or hide it on pages such as the checkout.

One-click connect, one-click portal

Connecting takes a minute: sign in to Marvoxa AI (or start a free trial), pick the agent that answers, and you’re back in WordPress. After that, Open Marvoxa AI on the plugin’s page signs you in to your Marvoxa AI portal in a new tab, no password needed. Conversations, leads, the agent’s look, voice and instructions, your plan and billing are all there.

Affordable, with a free trial

Every new account starts with a 7-day free trial, and no card is needed to start. After that, Website widget packages start from $5 a month, and the WordPress plugin is included with every one of them. See packages at ai.marvoxa.com.

More than a website chat

Marvoxa AI is an AI business platform. The same agent can also answer on WhatsApp, by email and through the developer API, and work with your other apps through connectors. All of it is set up in your Marvoxa AI portal.

External services

This plugin connects your site to Marvoxa AI, a service run by Marvoxa. It doesn’t work without it.

  • The chat on your site. Every front-end page (except ones you exclude) loads the chat script from https://ai-api.marvoxa.com/widget.js. When a visitor opens the chat or starts a call, what they type or say, and their browser’s address for the page, are sent to Marvoxa AI so the agent can answer.
  • Connecting. Clicking Connect with Marvoxa AI opens https://ai.marvoxa.com/portal/connect/wordpress with your site’s address. On the way back, the plugin sends the one-time code it got, and your site’s address, to https://ai-api.marvoxa.com/v1/wordpress/exchange, and receives the site’s API key.
  • Your agent’s knowledge. When syncing is on, the text of your published pages and your WooCommerce products (names, links, prices, stock, SKUs, categories, attributes, short descriptions), store address and shipping methods are sent to https://ai-api.marvoxa.com/v1/agents/…/knowledge hourly and after changes. Orders and customer details are never sent.
  • Opening your portal. Open Marvoxa AI (and the Conversations, Leads and plan buttons) asks https://ai-api.marvoxa.com/v1/wordpress/portal for a short-lived sign-in for the account that connected the site, then opens https://ai.marvoxa.com/api/portal/sso in a new tab with it, so you land in your portal signed in. It only runs when an admin clicks one of those buttons.
  • Status. The settings page asks https://ai-api.marvoxa.com/v1/wordpress/site for the agent’s name and whether it is live.
  • Disconnecting. Disconnecting or deleting the plugin tells https://ai-api.marvoxa.com/v1/wordpress/disconnect, so the site’s key stops working.

Nothing is sent before you connect. Marvoxa AI’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy apply.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Marvoxa AI” and click Install, then Activate. (Or upload the plugin’s zip under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.)
  2. Open Marvoxa AI in the admin menu and click Connect with Marvoxa AI.
  3. Sign in to Marvoxa AI (or click Create an account to make one), pick the agent that should answer on your site (or name a new one) and click Connect.
  4. You’re back in WordPress and the chat is live. Visit your site to try it.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Marvoxa AI account?

Yes. The agent, its answers, conversations and billing are in Marvoxa AI. If you don’t have one, click Create an account when you connect: new accounts start with a 7-day free trial, no card needed, and you come straight back to WordPress.

What happens when the free trial ends?

The plugin locks until you choose a plan in your Marvoxa AI portal: the chat stops showing on your site and your pages and products aren’t synced. Your agent and settings are kept, and the plugin’s page has a Choose a plan button. A site can only be connected while a plan or the free trial is running.

Where do I change the agent’s name, greeting, colours or voice?

In your Marvoxa AI portal. Click Open Marvoxa AI on the plugin’s page: it signs you in there, no password needed.

Can my team take over a conversation?

Yes. In your portal’s Conversations, anyone on your team can take over a chat and reply themselves, then hand it back to the AI. The AI stays quiet while a person has the chat.

Which languages does it speak?

It answers in the language your visitor writes or speaks in, by chat and by voice.

How much does it cost?

Every new account starts with a 7-day free trial, no card needed. After that, Website widget packages start from $5 a month, and the plugin is included with all of them. You choose and change your package in your Marvoxa AI portal.

Does it slow my site down?

The chat script loads asynchronously in the footer, after your page, so it doesn’t hold the page up.

Can I hide the chat on some pages?

Yes. On the plugin’s page, list the addresses to hide it on, one per line, for example /checkout or /blog/*. Developers can also use the marvoxa_ai_show_chat filter.

Which WooCommerce data does the agent see?

Products on sale (not hidden ones) with their prices, stock and details, and your shipping methods. Not orders, and not customers.

How do I disconnect?

Click Disconnect on the plugin’s page, or revoke the “WordPress · your-site” key on the Developers page of your Marvoxa AI portal.
